title: Design and Development of an Advanced Sensor Prototype for the Detection of Microplastics
content: Microplastics are ubiquitous in our environment and significantly threaten ecosystems and human health. This paper presents the design and fabrication of an innovative prototype sensor capable of detecting microplastics by employing multiple wavelengths. Our system combines mechanical, electronic, and optical components, providing an efficient and cost-effective solution for environmental monitoring.
